title: Cross-disorder Learning of Imaging-derived Joint Mophometric Markers in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's Diseases
abstract: arXiv:2610.27150v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As two most prevalent neurodegenerative diseases (NDDs), Alzheimer's disease (AD) and Parkinson's disease (PD) shared commonalities both in symptomology and pathophysiology. However, to what extent and in what way these two distinct disorders overlap remain underexplored. In this study, we propose an explicit, interpretable and spatially adaptive transfer learning framework to elucidate the morphometric biomarkers linked to AD and PD. We applied such high-dimensional machine learning model to two most popular open-source neuroimaging datasets, i.e., Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) and Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative (PPMI). translated_title: 阿尔茨海默病与帕金森病中基于影像的联合形态测量标志物的跨疾病学习
translated_abstract: 作为两种最为流行的神经退行性疾病（NDDs），阿尔茨海默病（AD）和帕金森病（PD）在症状学和病理生理学方面存在共同之处。然而，这两种不同的疾病在多大程度上以及以何种方式重叠，目前仍未得到充分探索。在本研究中，我们提出了一个显式、可解释且空间自适应的迁移学习框架，以阐明与AD和PD相关的形态测量生物标志物。我们将这种高维机器学习模型应用于两个最流行的开源神经影像数据集，即阿尔茨海默病神经影像计划（ADNI）和帕金森病进展标志物计划（PPMI）。一方面，我们的跨疾病分类器所揭示的神经解剖学改变模式与先前的神经影像研究结果高度一致，并突出了患者的临床表现。另一方面，使用共享先验训练的空间自适应分类器……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究提出一种显式、可解释且空间自适应的迁移学习框架，利用ADNI和PPMI神经影像数据集揭示阿尔茨海默病与帕金森病共享的形态测量生物标志物及与临床表现相符的神经解剖学改变模式。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an explicit, interpretable, and spatially adaptive transfer learning framework that reveals shared morphometric biomarkers and neuro-anatomical alteration patterns between Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases using the ADNI and PPMI neuroimaging datasets.
